description_sq:
Shitet direkt nga pronari apartament ne Ekspozita Building, nje nga ndertesat me te njohura ne Tirane, e vleresuar per cilesine e larte te ndertimit.
Organizimi:
Sallon me kuzhine ne koncept te hapur, 1 dhome gjumi dhe 1 tualet.
Siperfaqe totale: 114.16 m2
Apartamenti ka orientim jugor, me ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites dhe pamje te hapur urbane. Ndertesa ofron izolim termik dhe akustik me standard te larte, ashensore modern dhe administrim 24/7.
Ndodhet ne nje lokacion qendror, te konsoliduar dhe shume te kerkuar, ideal si per banim ashtu edhe per investim.
Ka mundesi per parkim nentokesor.
Cmimi: 3,500 EUR/m2
title_en: APARTMENT 1+1 EXHIBITION BUILDING (FOR SALE BY OWNER)
description_en: For sale directly by the owner, apartment in the Exhibition Building, one of the most popular buildings in Tirana, valued for the high quality of the construction. Layout: Living room with open concept kitchen, 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom. Total area: 114.16 m2 The apartment has a southern orientation, with natural lighting throughout the day and an open urban view. The building offers high standard thermal and acoustic insulation, modern elevator and 24/7 administration. It is located in a central, consolidated and highly sought-after location, ideal for both residence and investment. There is a possibility for underground parking. Price: 3,500 EUR/m2
